title: Argentina: review of politics, memory, football and crisis

items: I can review contrast, the passive, relative clauses, superlatives and cause connectors on Argentine topics.
I can use the words for Peronism, the dictatorship, football and the 2001 crisis.
I can read about modern Argentina and answer questions about what the texts say.
I can set two views of Peronism side by side with *sin embargo* and *no obstante* (review).
I can say what was done to people and institutions under the dictatorship with *ser* + participle (review).
I can describe the people the Abuelas de Plaza de Mayo are looking for with a relative clause and the subjunctive (review).
I can rank moments of Argentine football with *uno de los más…*.
I can give the causes of the 2001 crisis with *debido a* and *a raíz de* (review).
